about: Tasks for the repeated-rejection conversations. 'impossible' tasks have no correct answer; 'possible' tasks have an easy correct answer that the simulated user rejects anyway. The first 20 of each kind are the evaluation set; the last 10 of each kind are used only to build the DPO training pairs.
